summary: Applied 2 spec review repairs: constrained human progress to stderr and broadened failure artifact guidance to all artifact-producing final-regression failures.

items.title: Progress stream can corrupt envelope stdout
items.rationale: The spec now requires stderr for command, raw log path, heartbeat, and artifact-link output, and states stdout remains the JSON envelope.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R1-R4, constraints[3], design_principles[1], acceptance_criteria[0], and clarifications[3] now constrain progress output away from stdout.

items.title: Failure artifact output omits existing root-mismatch path
items.rationale: R4 and related acceptance now cover every final-regression failure path after artifact paths are created, including worktree root mismatch.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[3].desc and acceptance_criteria[2] now include worktree root mismatch and all artifact-producing final-regression failures.
